item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "05242e3d07a99a74f871ec59a1133d6d5e78150fa403cfa7812863e9503011f2",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "A grid structure on Cell and a measurable space Point. Its supplied constructor carries a domain, cell regions, nonemptiness of Cell, measurability of each region, pairwise disjointness, and exact coverage of the domain.",
      "effect_on_target": "The universally quantified grid supplies a nonempty family of measurable, pairwise disjoint regions partitioning its stored domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "The second projection of the grid, giving its function from cells to subsets of Point.",
      "effect_on_target": "Every measure, integrability condition, agreement condition, and average is evaluated on the region of the specified cell.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "For μ, region R, field f, and value a, the conjunction μ(R) ≠ 0, μ(R) ≠ ∞, integrability of f on R with respect to μ, and a = LocalDef004 μ R f.",
      "effect_on_target": "The assigned values must equal the specified normalized integrals, with the three validity conditions repeated in the conclusion. Uniqueness is among assignments satisfying this entire predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "The real scalar inverse of (μ(R)).toReal acting on MeasureTheory.integral (μ.restrict R) f.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the averaging formula exactly: Aμ,R(f) = ((μ(R)).toReal)⁻¹ • integral(μ.restrict R, f). The implementation of the integral itself is not exposed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Constructs a grid from a domain Ω, a region function R, a proof that Cell is nonempty, measurable regions, disjoint regions for unequal cells, and the equivalence x ∈ Ω iff some cell c satisfies x ∈ R(c).",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the grid's structural restrictions. Coverage and disjointness are pointwise, and no finiteness or countability of Cell is specified.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "All four conclusion clauses hold for the same assignment; all conditions inside LocalDef003 hold together.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "CompleteSpace",
      "meaning": "Completeness of the specified uniform space, meaning every Cauchy filter converges.",
      "effect_on_target": "Parameter is complete for its norm-induced uniform structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the function represented by a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows physicalVolume to be evaluated on a cell region using its measure-evaluation instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "ENNReal",
      "meaning": "Nonnegative real numbers with an added top element, represented by WithTop NNReal.",
      "effect_on_target": "Region measures lie in [0, ∞]; excluding zero and top restricts them to finite positive values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts exact equality of parameter values and equality of whole assignment functions, not approximate or almost-everywhere equality.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "There is one function assigned : Cell → Parameter satisfying all subsequent clauses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "MeasurableSpace",
      "meaning": "A measurable-space structure specifying a sigma-algebra of measurable subsets.",
      "effect_on_target": "Point has a sigma-algebra; no topology or metric on Point is requested.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn",
      "meaning": "IntegrableOn f R μ is defined as MeasureTheory.Integrable f (μ.restrict R).",
      "effect_on_target": "Integrability is required separately with respect to each restricted measure, not with respect to μ on all of Point. The underlying Integrable predicate is not expanded.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure",
      "meaning": "The measure type on the supplied measurable space.",
      "effect_on_target": "physicalVolume is an arbitrary measure on Point; its name supplies no further geometric or physical conditions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a measure on sets by evaluating its underlying outer measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The expressions physicalVolume(R) are ENNReal-valued measures of regions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "Excludes zero and infinite region measures and distinguishes indices in the grid's disjointness condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An additive commutative group with a separating norm and its compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Parameter has addition, subtraction, zero, and a norm, providing the value-space structure used by integration and completeness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric while forgetting norm separation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the same underlying norm and additive operations for the normed-space and topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A vector-space structure over a normed field compatible with the given norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Parameter is a real normed vector space; together with completeness it is a real Banach space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Extracts the interpretation of a natural-number numeral in the specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the literal 0 in the region-measure conditions as ENNReal zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the uniform-space structure of a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Completeness and the topology used for integrability refer to the uniform structure inherited from Parameter's norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number scalar type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Scalars, converted region measures, and their inverses are real numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The normed-field instance combining the real field operations with the real norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar normed-field structure for Parameter's real normed-space instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the pseudometric structure stored in a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects Parameter's norm to its uniform structure and topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining the norm, additive group, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same normed additive structure to the extended-norm instance used by integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "SeminormedAddGroup.toContinuousENorm",
      "meaning": "Constructs a continuous extended nonnegative norm from the group's nonnegative norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "The norm used by IntegrableOn is the extended-real version of Parameter's given norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Set",
      "meaning": "A subset of a type is a predicate on its elements.",
      "effect_on_target": "The domain and cell regions are subsets of Point with no additional geometric representation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Set.EqOn",
      "meaning": "EqOn f g R means that for every x, x ∈ R implies f(x) = g(x).",
      "effect_on_target": "The alternative field must agree exactly at every point of the selected region. It is unrestricted outside that region.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Top.top",
      "meaning": "Extracts a type's distinguished top element.",
      "effect_on_target": "The excluded top value of an ENNReal region measure is infinity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the topology associated with a uniform-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Integrability uses Parameter's norm-induced topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 using the specified zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "The positivity assumption compares the region measure with its actual ENNReal zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "instTopENNReal",
      "meaning": "The added top element of WithTop NNReal.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies infinity in the finite-measure assumptions and validity predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "instZeroENNReal",
      "meaning": "The zero inherited by WithTop NNReal from NNReal.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies zero measure in the nonzero-measure assumptions and validity predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, and the left and right additive identity laws from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the compatible zero and addition structures underlying Parameter's scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Projects the zero element from a structure carrying addition and zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the same parameter zero along the scalar-action instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and zero while forgetting their identity laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Maintains the underlying parameter operations used to elaborate scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "The scaling in LocalDef004 comes from the real module action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Projects scalar multiplication preserving zero from distributive scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries the same real scalar action toward the operation used by the average formula.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "ENNReal.toReal",
      "meaning": "Converts an ENNReal value by first applying toNNReal and then converting that nonnegative real to Real.",
      "effect_on_target": "The normalization uses this converted value, not an ENNReal inverse. Under the hypotheses the input is finite and nonzero. The supplied body does not expand the conversion's behavior at infinity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets separation of the extended norm while retaining the extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited algebraic structure for the parameter-space operations without changing the target's values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition, zero, and the additive commutative monoid laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive base for the real module structure used in averaging.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining the extended-seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the same parameter addition and zero through structure inheritance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides addition and zero to the scalar-action instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the operation of a heterogeneous scalar-multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Applies a real scalar to a Parameter-valued integral, returning a Parameter.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Inv.inv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the inverse operation from an inverse instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the real inverse of the converted region measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict",
      "meaning": "Applies the measure-valued linear map restrictₗ R to μ; this is the supplied restriction operation. Its underlying linear map is not expanded.",
      "effect_on_target": "The same restricted measure is used both for integrability and integration. In the usual measure-restriction interpretation, measurable A has restricted measure μ(A ∩ R); that identity is not exposed by this body.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.integral",
      "meaning": "A Parameter-valued operation on a measure and a field, whose supplied body is the opaque projection MeasureTheory.wrapped✝.1.",
      "effect_on_target": "It is the operation normalized by LocalDef004. Its identification with the Bochner integral and its conventions outside integrability cannot be independently verified from the supplied body.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Projects the distributive scalar action from a module structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects Parameter's real vector-space structure to the scalar multiplication in the average.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Builds an extended-normed additive commutative monoid from the normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "The inherited extended-norm and additive structures originate in Parameter's given normed group.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying module of a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar multiplication used to normalize the integral.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.instInv",
      "meaning": "Provides real inversion through the internal operation Real.inv'✝.",
      "effect_on_target": "The normalization scalar uses real field inversion; the finite positive region-measure hypotheses avoid a zero denominator.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.instMonoid",
      "meaning": "An inferred multiplicative monoid instance on Real.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar multiplication monoid for the real action; it introduces no additional quantified assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "An inferred semiring instance on Real.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar semiring required by Parameter's underlying real module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Projects scalar multiplication while forgetting its zero-preservation law.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar operation used by instHSMul in LocalDef004.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Treats an ordinary scalar multiplication α × β → β as heterogeneous scalar multiplication with result type β.",
      "effect_on_target": "Confirms that the normalized integral is formed by the existing real action on Parameter.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "CompleteAtomicBooleanAlgebra.toCompleteBooleanAlgebra",
      "meaning": "Forgets atomicity while preserving the complete Boolean algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in deriving the order structure on sets used for region disjointness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "CompleteBooleanAlgebra.toCompleteDistribLattice",
      "meaning": "Builds the inherited complete distributive lattice structure using the same complete lattice and Boolean operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the set-order instance chain; adds no geometric requirement on cells.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "CompleteBooleanAlgebra.toCompleteLattice",
      "meaning": "Projects the complete lattice.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the set lattice whose order is used in Disjoint.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "CompleteDistribLattice.toFrame",
      "meaning": "Projects the frame structure from a complete distributive lattice.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries the set lattice toward the bottom-element structure used for disjointness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "CompleteLattice.instOmegaCompletePartialOrder",
      "meaning": "Uses the complete lattice's partial order and defines each increasing sequence's supremum by its indexed supremum.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inherited partial-order instance on sets. It does not require a countable cell family.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Disjoint",
      "meaning": "Two ordered objects are disjoint if every common lower bound lies below bottom. For subsets under inclusion, their intersection is empty.",
      "effect_on_target": "Regions belonging to distinct cells have no common points, rather than merely intersecting in a null set.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "HeytingAlgebra.toOrderBot",
      "meaning": "Projects the order with a least element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the empty set as bottom for set disjointness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence, requiring both implications.",
      "effect_on_target": "The grid's domain is exactly the union of its cell regions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "MeasurableSet",
      "meaning": "Membership in the measurable-space structure's designated collection of measurable subsets.",
      "effect_on_target": "Every cell region is measurable by the grid constructor's requirements.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Membership.mem",
      "meaning": "Extracts the membership relation from a membership instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses point membership in the domain and cell regions, both in coverage and field agreement.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Nonempty",
      "meaning": "The type has at least one inhabitant.",
      "effect_on_target": "The grid requires at least one cell, excluding empty-index vacuity for an existing grid.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "OmegaCompletePartialOrder.toPartialOrder",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying partial order.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the set-inclusion order used by the expanded disjointness predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Order.Frame.toHeytingAlgebra",
      "meaning": "Retains the frame's lattice, top, bottom, implication, and complement as a Heyting algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the set bottom and order used to express empty intersection of distinct regions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Set.instCompleteAtomicBooleanAlgebra",
      "meaning": "The complete atomic Boolean algebra of subsets, with the inherited set Boolean operations and arbitrary suprema and infima.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the order infrastructure in terms of subset inclusion, unions, intersections, and the empty set.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Set.instMembership",
      "meaning": "Defines membership of an element in a set through Set.Mem, that is, satisfaction of the set's predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Coverage and EqOn concern actual points satisfying the region predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify types Cell, Point, and Parameter, with no specified cardinalities or dimensions.",
      "Equip Point with a measurable-space structure and Parameter with a normed additive commutative group, a compatible real normed-space structure, and completeness for its induced uniform structure.",
      "Universally quantify a grid on Cell and Point, a measure μ = physicalVolume on Point, and a field f = materialParameter : Point → Parameter.",
      "After the hypotheses, existentially quantify a single assignment a : Cell → Parameter. It may depend on the preceding structures, grid, measure, and field.",
      "In the first conclusion universally quantify c : Cell; in the uniqueness clause universally quantify b : Cell → Parameter.",
      "In the locality clause universally quantify c : Cell and g : Point → Parameter after a has been selected.",
      "In the constant-field clause universally quantify c : Cell and p : Parameter after a has been selected."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "The grid carries a domain Ω and regions R(c), with Cell nonempty, every R(c) measurable, distinct cells having disjoint regions, and x ∈ Ω if and only if there exists c with x ∈ R(c).",
      "For every cell c, μ(R(c)) ≠ 0.",
      "For every cell c, μ(R(c)) ≠ ∞. Together with the preceding condition, every region has finite positive measure.",
      "For every cell c, MeasureTheory.Integrable f (μ.restrict R(c)) holds."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "There exists a : Cell → Parameter such that for every c, μ(R(c)) ≠ 0, μ(R(c)) ≠ ∞, f is integrable with respect to μ.restrict R(c), and a(c) = Aμ,R(c)(f).",
      "For every b : Cell → Parameter, if for every c the same nonzero-measure, finite-measure, integrability, and equality-to-Aμ,R(c)(f) conditions hold for b(c), then b = a as functions.",
      "For every c and every g : Point → Parameter, if f(x) = g(x) for all x ∈ R(c), then a(c) = Aμ,R(c)(g).",
      "For every c and every p : Parameter, Aμ,R(c)(x ↦ p) = p. This clause concerns the averaging operator on constant fields and does not assert that the original field f is constant."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "Write mR = (μ(R)).toReal and I(ν,h) = MeasureTheory.integral ν h. Define Aμ,R(h) = mR⁻¹ • I(μ.restrict R,h), where • is real scalar multiplication on Parameter.",
      "LocalDef003 μ R h q is exactly the conjunction μ(R) ≠ 0, μ(R) ≠ ∞, MeasureTheory.Integrable h (μ.restrict R), and q = Aμ,R(h).",
      "Under the usual meanings of measure restriction and the Bochner integral, Aμ,R(h) is the normalized integral (1/μ(R)) • ∫R h dμ, with μ(R) regarded as a real number for finite-measure regions.",
      "Pointwise agreement on R means ∀ x ∈ R, f(x) = g(x); equality of assignments means equality at every cell.",
      "The normed-space and completeness assumptions make Parameter a real Banach space."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For any measurable space of points, real Banach space of parameter values, and grid consisting of a nonempty family of measurable, pairwise disjoint regions covering its domain exactly, let μ be a measure and f a parameter-valued field. Suppose each cell region has finite positive μ-measure and f is integrable with respect to the measure restricted to that region. Then there is a unique assignment of a parameter value to every cell satisfying the validity predicate: each value is the inverse real region measure times the specified integral of f over that region. The same assignment also has this locality property: replacing f by any field that agrees with it at every point of a chosen region leaves that region's computed value equal to its assigned value. Moreover, averaging any globally constant parameter-valued field over any cell returns that constant. The normalized-integral description uses the usual interpretation of the integration and restriction operations; their underlying implementations are not fully exposed in the packet."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "An existing grid requires a nonempty Cell type. Empty-index vacuity is therefore excluded, but for types admitting no grid the universal quantification over grid instances has no instances.",
    "The implication makes no assertion for a grid and measure with any zero-measure or infinite-measure cell, or for a field failing integrability on any cell.",
    "Finite positive cell measures force each cell region to be nonempty; together with the nonempty cell type this forces the grid domain and Point to be nonempty whenever the hypotheses hold.",
    "Cell need not be finite or countable. Neither μ(Point) nor μ(Ω) is required to be finite, and global integrability of f is not assumed.",
    "The grid has exact disjointness, not disjointness modulo null sets. No Euclidean geometry, cell shape, mesh size, regularity, or adjacency is encoded.",
    "Parameter need not be scalar-valued or finite-dimensional, and may be the trivial real Banach space. No order, positivity, or physical admissibility condition on its values is encoded.",
    "The alternative field g has no separate global measurability or integrability hypothesis. Its condition is exact pointwise agreement on the selected region; no claim with merely almost-everywhere agreement is explicitly stated.",
